# Bootstrap Tab 5.3.8

Official Bootstrap Tab plugin installed from the `bootstrap@5.3.8` npm package.

`js/bootstrap-tab.js` contains only Tab and its required Bootstrap modules, in dependency order:

- `util/index.js`
- `dom/data.js`
- `dom/event-handler.js`
- `dom/manipulator.js`
- `util/config.js`
- `base-component.js`
- `dom/selector-engine.js`
- `tab.js`
